nuggets.text: Bijan Robinson set the Falcons' single-season scrimmage-yards record with 2,255 yards in 2025.
Robinson's 93-yard TD run in 2025 was the NFL's longest that year and Atlanta's first 90-yard run since 2006.
John Abraham's 68.5 sacks in Atlanta are the most in franchise history since sacks became official in 1982.
Bill Fralic's dominant blocking at Pitt is credited with inspiring the term 'pancake block.'
Matt Ryan, Atlanta's all-time passing leader, became the Falcons' first-ever President of Football in 2026.
Tua Tagovailoa beat out Michael Penix Jr. to win the Falcons' Week 1 starting quarterback job in 2026.
Kevin Stefanski takes over as Falcons head coach in 2026 after leading the Browns from 2020 to 2025.
Bijan Robinson, Chris Lindstrom, Jessie Bates III, Divine Deablo and Nick Folk are Atlanta's 2026 team captains.
The Falcons will play the Bengals at Real Madrid's Bernabéu Stadium in Week 9, their sixth game outside the U.S.
Atlanta debuts new uniforms in 2026, wearing white on the road to open the season at Pittsburgh.
